currentContext.expansion: Expansion is described only in the MD's message. As of March 2026 the Company reports approximately 16.8 million square feet under construction, with a pipeline of approximately 7.9 million square feet scheduled for launch in the near future (planned launches, not yet under construction). Geographic expansion is through carefully selected markets: following completion of AGI Sky Villas at Ludhiana, the Company strengthened its Ludhiana presence by acquiring a 60% stake in World Next Realty LLP (acquired 12 March 2026), and entered New Chandigarh with the launch of AGI UTOPIA, which has been recognised under the Iconic Building of Punjab Policy of the Government of Punjab — a recognition management says brings project-level benefits on approval fees and associated costs. Execution capability is being upgraded through MIVAN aluminium formwork technology, and the Company has joined hands with the Construction Skill Development Council of India to work towards establishing a Centre of Excellence in Punjab (an intention, not a commissioned facility). The Directors' Report states a QIP of Rs.7500 Lakhs was raised in the quarter ended 31 March 2026, of which Rs.5600 Lakhs was earmarked for investment in construction of ongoing projects, with part of the proceeds still unutilised at 31 March 2026. A rooftop solar generation system has been set up in a project developed by the Company, along with dual plumbing, to cut electricity and ground-water use; no capacity figure is disclosed for it. No capacity table and no named capex disclosure appear in this bundle.

- The Risk Management Policy section states the Company's 'business is significantly dependent on agricultural produce, which is highly seasonal' and that this may affect consumers' purchasing power. This is the only risk the Board's risk-management section names, but it contradicts the report's own description of the Company as a Group Housing developer, so it is recorded as disclosed and flagged as inconsistent rather than adopted as a finding.
- The report states Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting under Regulation 34(2) does not apply to the Company for FY 2025-26, so no BRSR material-issues table, concentration disclosure or assured ESG metrics are available to assess risk against.
